result.description:
A well-established  mixed-billing  medical centre is seeking a  Vocational Registered (VR) General Practitioner  to provide comprehensive, continuing medical care to individuals, families, and the surrounding communities. The practice is situated in a highly desirable location, offering excellent lifestyle benefits due to its proximity to the Eastern suburbs beaches. 

 The practice environment is collaborative and highly supportive, led by an experienced and approachable Medical Director and a dedicated Practice Manager. GPs will benefit from a strong team dynamic and experienced administrative support designed to help develop their practice from day one. Qualified nursing support is readily available, assisting with all treatment room procedures, Health Assessments, and Chronic Disease Management (CDM) Care Plans. The centre supports a broad scope of practice, and practitioners are encouraged to pursue special interests, provide ongoing education, and participate in research. 

 Practitioners are afforded significant clinical autonomy and flexible working arrangements, allowing them to structure their practice using appointments, walk-ins, or telehealth consults based on personal preference. The centre supports professional development through access to accredited CPD webinars and training opportunities. To accommodate varied professional needs, short-term agreements and no exclusivity requirement options are available. This is an ideal role for a VR GP who desires a supportive clinical team, high flexibility, and an unbeatable Sydney Eastern suburbs coastal lifestyle. The convenience of designated GP car parking is also provided.   Apply Now
